verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Scores raw length and punctuation quantity while explicitly disallowing any judgment of whether that amount is good, so it is a pure extent/verbosity measure, not a quality judgment.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures how much shouted or capitalised typography is present, a typographic habit rather than an evaluation of the entry's craft or content.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether the wording sets up and subverts an expectation, a genuine structural/comic-craft feature of the joke itself.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Counts words, characters, and connective marks devoted to scaffolding while explicitly disclaiming any judgment of whether the scaffolding is helpful, so it is a pure length/punctuation-quantity measure.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Scores conformity to the contest's settled formal conventions, a community/venue style marker the rubric itself says is not a quality judgment, though practiced regulars who follow convention may also happen to write more skillfully.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether the topical reference does real argumentative work (names a specific contradiction) rather than just naming a figure, genuine content quality, and explicitly guards against rewarding vocabulary or punctuation as a proxy.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures whether the entry reads as a deliberate swerve away from an assumed default response, explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgment, though the underlying awareness of prior takes plausibly comes with practiced entrants who also write better.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures how close the entry's move sits to the obvious, first-available response, explicitly disclaimed as orthogonal to execution or wit, a positional tell with no clear quality-producing upstream cause.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether the intended comic relation can be reconstructed unaided, a genuine craft measure of the joke's legibility, explicitly not a byproduct of length or formatting.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Counts quotation marks, capitalisation, and overall length as an apparatus/extent measure, explicitly not judging whether any target is recognizable or the marking appropriate.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether grammar and phrasing choices are under the writer's control in service of the joke, a genuine craft measure distinct from punctuation or typographic correctness.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether the intended target is actually identifiable from the wording without guesswork, a genuine clarity/craft measure of execution.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Counts trailing hashtags, handles, or byline furniture appended after the text, a pure formatting/template feature unrelated to the entry's comic content.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether the derivation from source to comic result is legible without invented steps, a genuine craft measure rather than one of scaffolding volume.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures reliance on an unexplained running joke shared among contest regulars, an insider/community marker the rubric says is not a quality judgment, though such familiarity plausibly comes from practiced entrants who also write more skillfully.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures how peripheral or central the chosen prompt material is, explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgment, though noticing a narrow detail may reflect a more careful, practiced entrant who also writes better.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures whether the wording frames the entry as one of many submitted in a batch, a template/formatting tell explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgment, though prolific batch-submitters may also be more practiced writers.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether the entry has one coherent governing comic idea that all details serve, a genuine measure of comic focus and craft.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Estimates lexical heaviness, reading difficulty, and punctuation density as a mechanical texture measure, explicitly not judging whether the style is good, apt, or clear.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Estimates the bulk of words, clauses, and punctuation marks wrapping an alteration, explicitly counting packaging rather than judging whether it is clever or warranted.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Estimates overall length and average word length as a size/bulk measure, explicitly not judging whether that bulk is warranted or funny.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether a specific, concrete particular rather than a generic label carries the joke, a genuine measure of comic specificity and content quality.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judges whether the alteration produces a fresh, apt implication beyond a plain substitution, a genuine measure of comic ingenuity, explicitly disclaiming length or punctuation as a proxy.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Measures how tightly vocabulary and references date the entry to a specific period, a temporal tell the rubric explicitly says is neither credited nor penalised as quality.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Estimates density of punctuation, typographic marks, and capitalisation-based emphasis relative to length, explicitly not judging correctness, necessity, or elegance.
